entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I bought a jersey a little while ago, and I was so excited for it, but... it just doesn't fit. I feel so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference on the fit?

Oh, it's just a preference, I guess. I ordered the wrong size. It's just far too tight in the shoulders. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had this problem before. I was really hoping to use it for a charity ride.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for a comfortable ride. Let me just pull up our policy. Can I get your order number, please?
Sure, it's VF-8675309. I really hope there's something you can do. With things being so tight lately, I really needed that money back if it wasn't going to work out.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 42 days ago. I'm happy to tell you that your jersey is well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you!
Of course. I can either process a return for a full refund, or I can help you start an exchange for a different size right now. Whichever you prefer.
An exchange would be perfect! I'd love to get the next size up. Thank you so much, David. You've really made my day.
It's my pleasure. Let's get that started for you right away. I'll just need to confirm your shipping address...
